product.name: Marketplace Platform for AWS, Azure, and GCP
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables listing, co-selling, and transacting on AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces from a single interface.

product.name: Co-Sell and Resell Automation
product.description: Automated workflows and CRM integrations to manage co-sell and resell activities, track referrals, and accelerate deal pipelines.

product.name: Usage Metering and Billing Automation
product.description: A system that converts raw usage data into accurate billing outputs with flexible pricing and consolidated reporting across cloud marketplaces.

identifier.value: Flexible Billing for Azure Private Offers

product.name: Flexible Billing for Azure Private Offers
product.description: Enables sellers to create customized billing schedules for Azure Private Offers, aligning payments with buyer budget cycles and timelines.

product.name: Custom Email Notification Builder
product.description: A tool to create, configure, and test personalized email notifications for cloud marketplace sales and co-sell workflows.
